mapper.select: SELECT P.*, NVL(ROUND(AVG(R.RATING), 1), 0) AS averageRating, COUNT(R.REVIEW_ID) AS reviewCount FROM PRODUCT P LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_REVIEW R ON P.PRODUCT_ID = R.PRODUCT_ID GROUP BY P.PRODUCT_ID, P.CATEGORY_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.BRAND, P.MODEL_NAME, P.PRICE, P.STOCK, P.CPU, P.RAM, P.STORAGE_CAPACITY, P.SCREEN_SIZE, P.OS, P.COLOR, P.DESCRIPTION, P.IMAGE_NAME, P.IMAGE_PATH, P.STATUS, P.SALES_COUNT, P.CREATED_AT, P.UPDATED_AT ORDER BY P.PRODUCT_ID DESC

SELECT P.*, NVL(ROUND(AVG(R.RATING), 1), 0) AS averageRating, COUNT(R.REVIEW_ID) AS reviewCount FROM PRODUCT P LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_REVIEW R ON P.PRODUCT_ID = R.PRODUCT_ID WHERE P.PRODUCT_ID = #{productId} GROUP BY P.PRODUCT_ID, P.CATEGORY_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.BRAND, P.MODEL_NAME, P.PRICE, P.STOCK, P.CPU, P.RAM, P.STORAGE_CAPACITY, P.SCREEN_SIZE, P.OS, P.COLOR, P.DESCRIPTION, P.IMAGE_NAME, P.IMAGE_PATH, P.STATUS, P.SALES_COUNT, P.CREATED_AT, P.UPDATED_AT
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PRODUCT ( PRODUCT_ID, CATEGORY_ID, PRODUCT_NAME, BRAND, MODEL_NAME, PRICE, STOCK, CPU, RAM, STORAGE_CAPACITY, SCREEN_SIZE, OS, COLOR, DESCRIPTION, IMAGE_NAME, IMAGE_PATH, STATUS, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_PRODUCT.NEXTVAL, #{categoryId}, #{productName}, #{brand}, #{modelName}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{cpu}, #{ram}, #{storageCapacity}, #{screenSize}, #{os}, #{color}, #{description}, #{imageName}, #{imagePath}, 'SALE', SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE PRODUCT SET CATEGORY_ID = #{categoryId}, PRODUCT_NAME = #{productName}, BRAND = #{brand}, MODEL_NAME = #{modelName}, PRICE = #{price}, STOCK = #{stock}, CPU = #{cpu}, RAM = #{ram}, STORAGE_CAPACITY = #{storageCapacity}, SCREEN_SIZE = #{screenSize}, OS = #{os}, COLOR = #{color}, DESCRIPTION = #{description}, IMAGE_NAME = #{imageName}, IMAGE_PATH = #{imagePath}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}
mapper.select: SELECT P.*, NVL(ROUND(AVG(R.RATING), 1), 0) AS averageRating, COUNT(R.REVIEW_ID) AS reviewCount FROM PRODUCT P LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_REVIEW R ON P.PRODUCT_ID = R.PRODUCT_ID WHERE P.PRODUCT_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' GROUP BY P.PRODUCT_ID, P.CATEGORY_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.BRAND, P.MODEL_NAME, P.PRICE, P.STOCK, P.CPU, P.RAM, P.STORAGE_CAPACITY, P.SCREEN_SIZE, P.OS, P.COLOR, P.DESCRIPTION, P.IMAGE_NAME, P.IMAGE_PATH, P.STATUS, P.SALES_COUNT, P.CREATED_AT, P.UPDATED_AT ORDER BY P.PRODUCT_ID DESC

SELECT P.*, NVL(ROUND(AVG(R.RATING), 1), 0) AS averageRating, COUNT(R.REVIEW_ID) AS reviewCount FROM PRODUCT P LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_REVIEW R ON P.PRODUCT_ID = R.PRODUCT_ID WHERE P.CATEGORY_ID = #{categoryId} GROUP BY P.PRODUCT_ID, P.CATEGORY_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.BRAND, P.MODEL_NAME, P.PRICE, P.STOCK, P.CPU, P.RAM, P.STORAGE_CAPACITY, P.SCREEN_SIZE, P.OS, P.COLOR, P.DESCRIPTION, P.IMAGE_NAME, P.IMAGE_PATH, P.STATUS, P.SALES_COUNT, P.CREATED_AT, P.UPDATED_AT ORDER BY P.PRODUCT_ID DESC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY P.PRODUCT_ID DESC) RN, P.*, NVL(ROUND(AVG(R.RATING), 1), 0) AS averageRating, COUNT(R.REVIEW_ID) AS reviewCount FROM PRODUCT P LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_REVIEW R ON P.PRODUCT_ID = R.PRODUCT_ID GROUP BY P.PRODUCT_ID, P.CATEGORY_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.BRAND, P.MODEL_NAME, P.PRICE, P.STOCK, P.CPU, P.RAM, P.STORAGE_CAPACITY, P.SCREEN_SIZE, P.OS, P.COLOR, P.DESCRIPTION, P.IMAGE_NAME, P.IMAGE_PATH, P.STATUS, P.SALES_COUNT, P.CREATED_AT, P.UPDATED_AT ) WHERE RN BETWEEN #{startRow} AND #{endRow}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY P.PRODUCT_ID DESC) RN, P.*, NVL(ROUND(AVG(R.RATING), 1), 0) AS averageRating, COUNT(R.REVIEW_ID) AS reviewCount FROM PRODUCT P LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_REVIEW R ON P.PRODUCT_ID = R.PRODUCT_ID WHERE P.CATEGORY_ID = #{categoryId} GROUP BY P.PRODUCT_ID, P.CATEGORY_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.BRAND, P.MODEL_NAME, P.PRICE, P.STOCK, P.CPU, P.RAM, P.STORAGE_CAPACITY, P.SCREEN_SIZE, P.OS, P.COLOR, P.DESCRIPTION, P.IMAGE_NAME, P.IMAGE_PATH, P.STATUS, P.SALES_COUNT, P.CREATED_AT, P.UPDATED_AT ) WHERE RN BETWEEN #{startRow} AND #{endRow}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT P.*, NVL(ROUND(AVG(R.RATING), 1), 0) AS averageRating, COUNT(R.REVIEW_ID) AS reviewCount FROM PRODUCT P LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_REVIEW R ON P.PRODUCT_ID = R.PRODUCT_ID WHERE P.STATUS = 'SALE' GROUP BY P.PRODUCT_ID, P.CATEGORY_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.BRAND, P.MODEL_NAME, P.PRICE, P.STOCK, P.CPU, P.RAM, P.STORAGE_CAPACITY, P.SCREEN_SIZE, P.OS, P.COLOR, P.DESCRIPTION, P.IMAGE_NAME, P.IMAGE_PATH, P.STATUS, P.SALES_COUNT, P.CREATED_AT, P.UPDATED_AT ORDER BY P.SALES_COUNT DESC, P.PRODUCT_ID DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 6

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT P.*, NVL(ROUND(AVG(R.RATING), 1), 0) AS averageRating, COUNT(R.REVIEW_ID) AS reviewCount FROM PRODUCT P LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_REVIEW R ON P.PRODUCT_ID = R.PRODUCT_ID GROUP BY P.PRODUCT_ID, P.CATEGORY_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.BRAND, P.MODEL_NAME, P.PRICE, P.STOCK, P.CPU, P.RAM, P.STORAGE_CAPACITY, P.SCREEN_SIZE, P.OS, P.COLOR, P.DESCRIPTION, P.IMAGE_NAME, P.IMAGE_PATH, P.STATUS, P.SALES_COUNT, P.CREATED_AT, P.UPDATED_AT ORDER BY P.CREATED_AT DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 6
mapper.update: UPDATE PRODUCT SET SALES_COUNT = NVL(SALES_COUNT, 0) + #{quantity}, STOCK = STOCK - #{quantity}, STATUS = CASE WHEN STOCK - #{quantity} <= 0 THEN 'SOLD_OUT' ELSE STATUS END, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId} AND STOCK >= #{quantity}

UPDATE PRODUCT SET SALES_COUNT = GREATEST(NVL(SALES_COUNT, 0) - #{quantity}, 0), STOCK = STOCK + #{quantity}, STATUS = CASE WHEN STOCK + #{quantity} > 0 THEN 'SALE' ELSE STATUS END, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}
